Hawaii Packing List

Clothing:
- Swimsuits
- Cover-ups
- Lightweight shorts and t-shirts
- Sundresses or skirts
- Light long-sleeved shirts for sun protection
- Comfortable walking sandals
- Flip-flops
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Pants or jeans for dinners or cooler days

Toiletries:
- Sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher)
- Aloe vera gel (for sunburn relief)
- Shampoo and conditioner (travel-sized)
- Body wash or soap (travel-sized)
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Razor
- Hairbrush or comb
- Hair ties or clips
- Makeup and makeup remover
- Skincare products
- Insect repellent
- Wet wipes or hand sanitizer

Accessories:
- Sunglasses with UV protection
- Wide-brimmed hat or cap
- Reef-safe beach bag
- Waterproof phone case or dry bag
- Water bottle
- Snorkel gear (if needed)

Electronics:
- Waterproof camera or GoPro
- Waterproof phone case
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Waterproof speaker (optional)

Miscellaneous:
- Beach towel or sarong
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Waterproof bag for wet swimsuits
- Travel documents (passport, ID, tickets)
- Credit cards and cash
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Reusable shopping bag
